content:
The **Autumn Acre Cabin** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

A small house precariously perched on the edge of a stunning vista in the Savage Divide. It was once the home of a novelist, G.D. Blorwood, with a particular case of writer's block, as well as hatred for dismissive publishers. [1] Many Empty Wine Bottles were left behind by the former inhabitant.

This quiet cabin sits on a hill overlooking the Savage Divide's border with The Mire. A pack of Feral Ghouls have overrun the exterior, and they can be led by a high level Glowing One or Wendigo. Otherwise, a pack of Wolves led by an alpha will be in the area. Inside, there is a Steamer Trunk and Suitcase that can be looted in the bedroom. A number of Woodpiles are scattered about the location.

The Autumn Acre Cabin appears in *Fallout 76*.
